test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A - B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

If P - Q + R @ S + T, then how is P related to T?
solution:

Broother

Husband

Given: P - Q + R @ S + T

It means: P is the Mother of Q, Q is the Brother of R, R is the Son of S, and S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d363f6435cc55e7e0402e33f2f87d1a9ea1bfbfa08d541fd42e2e76e522c4599.png] 

So, P is the '**Brother’s wife**' of T.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
